summary.text: Robert Marvin is the Republican candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 38B in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Samantha Vang; the Republican primary was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Robert Marvin ran for the Minnesota State Senate in District 40 in 2016 and 2020, losing both general elections to incumbent Chris Eaton.
He was the Republican candidate for Minnesota House District 40B in 2018, when Samantha Vang defeated him in the general election.
Marvin was also the Republican nominee in District 38B in 2022 and 2024, and Vang won both general elections; in 2024 he received 25.4 percent of the vote.
